Red/maroon is used for borders, titles, and error-related symbols (δ_j, t_j−O_j); blue for weights and O_i in formulas; green for nodes and the O_j(1−O_j) factor.

visual_elements.description: Backpropagation output-layer diagram: 3 green input circles (left, vertically stacked, each labeled O_i in red) fully connected by thin gray lines to 3 peach output circles (middle, vertically stacked, each labeled δ_j in red on the left and O_j in red on the right); each connection group is labeled w_ji in blue. From each output circle a rightward arrow enters the left side of a tall vertical rectangle labeled 'Error' (text rotated 90° CCW). From each of 3 blue rectangles labeled t_j (far right, vertically stacked) a leftward arrow enters the right side of the Error box. A small red upward-pointing arrow sits below the bottom output circle, highlighting its δ_j.

recreation_brief: 1. Add a white slide; draw a thin maroon (#A93226) rectangle border inset ~3% from all edges to frame the slide. 2. Top-left: text box with 'At Output Layer', font bold, ~30pt, color #A93226, underline on. 3. Top-right: yellow (#FFFF00) circle ~0.55in diameter with dark (#7F6000) outline; center the text '12' in black ~16pt. 4. Center: draw a large rectangle with maroon (#A93226) 1.5pt border, white fill, spanning roughly x 15-85%, y 20-73% of the slide. 5. Inside it, left column: three circles (~0.45in) filled #C6E0B4 with #70AD47 border, vertically spaced; to the upper-right of each, red (#FF0000) italic label 'O_i'. 6. Draw thin gray lines from each green circle to each orange circle (fully connected 3x3); place blue (#0070C0) italic 'w_ji' labels along the lines between the columns (three labels, one per row band). 7. Middle column: three circles filled #F8CBAD with #ED7D31 border; place red italic 'δ_j' at the left of each and red italic 'O_j' at the right of each. 8. Below the bottom orange circle, insert a small red upward arrow shape pointing at that node. 9. Right of the orange nodes: a tall vertical rectangle (~0.6in wide, ~2.2in tall), white fill, maroon (#A93226) border; inside, the word 'Error' rotated -90° (reading bottom-to-top), dark red/black, bold. 10. Draw rightward arrows from each orange node into the left edge of the Error box. 11. Far right: three rectangles (~0.9in x 0.35in) filled #BDD7EE with #2E75B6 border, vertically aligned with the orange nodes; each contains red italic 't_j'; draw leftward arrows from each blue box into the right edge of the Error box. 12. Along the bottom inside the main rectangle: a pale-green (#E2EFDA) bar containing one line of mixed-color text: 'Δ_ji = η' black, 'O_i' blue (#0070C0), 'O_j(1−O_j)' green (#00B050), '(t_j − O_j)' red (#FF0000), using italic math font with subscripts, ~20pt. 13. Bottom-left of slide: a white rectangle with maroon (#A93226) border (~x 7-48%, y 75-92%); line 1: 'Δ_ji = η   O_i   δ_j' with O_i in blue and δ_j in red; line 2: 'Where:   δ_j = O_j(1−O_j)  (t_j − O_j)' with δ_j red, O_j(1−O_j) green, (t_j − O_j) red; 'Where:' and '=' in black; ~18pt italic math for symbols. 14. Use the minus sign '−' (U+2212) in the formulas exactly as shown; keep spacing between the color-coded segments as on the slide.
